 Cricketer Dr. Ishan Pandey Appointed Brand Ambassador for Abhivadan Expeditions Holidays
 Ratopati
 November 18, 2026
 Read in Nepali
 Kathmandu. Nepali national cricket team player Dr. Ishan Pandey has been appointed as the brand ambassador of Abhivadan Expeditions Holidays. Abhivadan Expeditions Holidays Pvt. Ltd. has appointed Pandey as the brand ambassador with the objective of promoting Nepal's tourism and supporting Nepali cricket. 
 The agreement was signed on Tuesday at Hotel Ji Ramayana in Nayabazar, Kathmandu. Abhivadan Expeditions Holidays Chairman Dr. Umesh Gupta and cricketer Pandey signed the agreement. 
 The program was organized under the management of Wego Global. As a brand ambassador, Pandey will represent the company in various promotional campaigns and activities. The company stated that this partnership aims to connect Nepali cricket and tourism in a single campaign. 
 Abhivadan Expeditions Holidays has been providing tourism-related services in this region for over 27 years. After the agreement, the company's chairman Dr. Umesh Gupta expressed his happiness in welcoming Pandey as the company's brand ambassador. 
 'For over 27 years, Abhivadan has been introducing travelers to the best destinations in Nepal and this region. Our brand wishes to represent the discipline, energy, and spirit of national pride that Dr. Ishan Pandey possesses,' Gupta said. 
 After being appointed as the brand ambassador, Pandey also expressed his pride in being associated with Abhivadan Expeditions Holidays. 'There are many attractive destinations for tourists in Nepal. While representing the country from the national team, I hope to contribute to making Nepal's tourism known worldwide,' Pandey said. 
 Both parties believe that this partnership will help promote Nepali cricket and introduce Nepal's tourism sector to the international level.
